svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of one small filled hole through a flat pale oxide down to a thin purple pad. Before the step a cross-hatched grey metal fills the hole and covers the whole top. After it the metal and its thin purple lining are gone from the top, which is flat oxide, and the metal remains only in the hole as a plug flush with the oxide.
svg.desc: Two enlarged cross-sections of one small filled hole through a flat pale oxide down to a thin purple pad. Before the step a cross-hatched grey metal fills the hole and covers the whole top. svg.text: The tungsten and the liner are polished
off the field, down to the oxide.
After: a tungsten plug, flush with the oxide
Close-up of the right-hand metal contact, enlarged
about 2.7×; the lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
